notes.title: Support Campaign for “hololive English 3rd Concert -All for One-”!
notes.notes:
[p]To (unofficially) support the [i]hololive English 3rd Concert -All for One-[/i] (August 23–24, 2025), we’ve released Update Ver.1.0.8![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/95699bd6f2f36452e087cfdc1991ca53edc22dfc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Update Contents[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added three members of [b]Myth[/b], appearing in the concert, as new Treasures![/p][p]Simply launch the game to unlock:[/p][p]• Mori Calliope[/p][p]• Takanashi Kiara[/p][p]• Ninomae Ina’nis[/p][p]On any stage where you’ve earned [b]3 Stars[/b], you can now use the [b]Treasure Swap[/b] feature.[/p][p]※Swap the stage’s set Treasure with one you’ve already unlocked, and enjoy clearing the stage with your favorite member![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Takodachi[/b] as a new playable mascot character!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/e1351311d51b35350f0cb299601f12243b072d9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This fluffy little friend floats around and pushes Treasures in a mysterious yet adorable way—be sure to give it a try![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Bonus Character “Kumarin” – Link with Treasure Mountain!
notes.notes: [p][b]A surprise appearance!? notes.title: Now Available: Free Demo of hololive GOROGORO MOUNTAIN
notes.notes:
[h3]hololive GoroGoro Mountain – Free Demo Now Available on Steam![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/5ef194144839350c0212b1e9081d1981d5720efb.png[/img]

Time to climb a mountain!?  
The free demo of [b]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/b], a lively 3D action game where you roll adorable treasures to the goal for Captain Houshou Marine, is now available on Steam!

[b]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/b] is a fun and playful 3D puzzle-action game starring the popular hololive VTuber [b]Houshou Marine[/b].

The demo includes two stages: a “Normal” stage to learn the basics, and a “Hard” stage for a true challenge.  
Roll, throw, and strategize your way to the goal—experience the full joy of [b]GoroGoro Action[/b]!

[h3]▼ Roll for your Oshi! Push Captain Marine to the top![/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/6d20f54c29e94b53fb2eae7ea9e97e0005e975fa.png[/img]

You’ll join the crew as a loyal Ichimi (Captain Marine’s fan) and roll treasures based on hololive members…

Each treasure has a unique shape and rolling style depending on the talent—mastering the controls won’t be easy!  
Will it roll off the edge? Fly in a strange direction? Unexpected twists await on this chaotic climb!

[h3]▼ Throw it for a game-changing move![/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/f084365602befb3d7acf56eea050efa1308a69ba.png[/img]

In this game, you don’t just roll—you can throw the treasures too!  
Plot your route and take it slow, or go bold with a high-flying shortcut.  
The key to success lies in your creativity and daring spirit!

[h3]▼ A wild ride with chattering treasures![/h3]

The treasures are as lively as ever!  
Just like in the previous title, [b]hololive Treasure Mountain[/b], every roll or throw comes with cheerful voice lines—cheering you on, teasing, or cracking a joke mid-climb!

[h3]▼ Try the free special stages now![/h3]

Sometimes you roll, sometimes you throw—join the Ichimi and aim for the top with Captain Marine!  
Try the demo today and experience the chaos and charm of [b]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/b]!
